This release fixes a freeze and cleans up the calendar set editor and the panel's text fields.

## Fixes

- Daybar no longer freezes when you switch to search or start a new event while quick add is showing a preview of what you typed.
- The panel's text fields no longer swell or dim when you click them. A focus ring now shows which field you're typing in, and clicking anywhere in a field puts the cursor there.
- After you close the calendar set sheet, Settings stays active instead of looking dimmed.
- The set editor uses standard sheet buttons, with Delete on the left. Each account has a checkbox that checks or unchecks all of its calendars. It shows a dash when only some of them are checked.
- Calendar color dots in the set editor are spaced evenly between the checkbox and the name.

## Install

Download `Daybar.dmg` below, open it, and drag Daybar to your Applications folder, replacing the old version. Daybar needs macOS 27 or later.

The app and disk image are signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple. To check your download, compare it with `Daybar.dmg.sha256`, or verify its build provenance:

```sh
gh attestation verify Daybar.dmg --repo firatciftci/daybar
```
